summary: Tested the new nav-language-sync-pill feature end-to-end. Backend PUT /api/auth/language validated (5 pytest cases, all pass). Frontend Playwright run covers all 6 user-stated scenarios — pill hidden when logged out, visible above Properties when logged in, contains globe icon + green dot + 'Synced across your devices' + current-language label + 'Switch to {other}' hint, click toggles UI language AND fires PUT to backend, value persists across reload (admin's preferred_language updates), and cross-device simulation via a second login session sees the new value. All scenarios PASS.

issues: Minor a11y: i18n.changeLanguage() updates the UI text but does NOT update document.documentElement.lang or dir. After toggling to Hebrew the page visually renders in Hebrew (RTL text), but <html lang="en" dir="ltr"> stays unchanged. Screen readers and CSS direction queries (:dir(rtl)) will be wrong. Not a regression of this feature but worth a single-line addition in i18n init (i18n.on('languageChanged', l => { document.documentElement.lang = l; document.documentElement.dir = l.startsWith('he') ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'; })).

action_items: Optional polish: sync <html lang> and dir attributes when i18n.changeLanguage() runs — helps screen readers and CSS [dir=rtl] selectors. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: Navigation.js toggleLanguage is fire-and-forget on the PUT (intentional per spec — UI works even if backend fails). Confirmed working as designed.
Pill click also closes the menu (setMenuOpen(false)) which is good UX.
Pill is correctly gated on `user` so unauthenticated visitors never see it.
i18n.js keys nav.languageSynced / nav.english / nav.hebrew / nav.switchTo are present in both en and he resources.
Backend /auth/language validates 'en'|'he' and rejects anything else with 400/422 (Pydantic enum).
seed_data_creation: None. Admin's preferred_language was reset to 'en' at end of both backend (pytest teardown fixture) and frontend (final UI toggle) runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pill is at [data-testid=nav-language-sync-pill] inside [data-testid=nav-menu-dropdown]. Token is in sessionStorage per App.js init. Tests confirmed pill visibility, text composition, position above 'Properties' section, PUT /api/auth/language firing on click with correct body, reload persistence via /auth/me preferred_language, and cross-device sync via fresh login. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_language_pill.py and pass in ~2s. Admin language is reset to 'en' after every run.
